apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.29 — Lifecycle-scoped playback: screens now listen to playback only while they are visible and their own playback is live. The waveform, the swara chip strip, the Varisai grid and the raga page all go quiet when covered, tabbed away from, backgrounded, or when another studio plays — and scrolling stays smooth during every kind of playback.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
